quotes.author: Caitlin
quotes.text: Great experience with a lot of fun and a lot of laughs. The phenomenal weather helped as well! We got to see dolphins and a sea turtle . Jay and Jason were excellent hosts and tour guide guides!!

quotes.text: Best way to top off our beach day! My girls were nervous and felt so safe and had a blast for their first time parasailing!
